book.name: Faisok
book.title: A Maana Faisok Sina Mu Yaamut Na Luuk A Lisan A Fataraguiaana Lagasai Xe Si Tiofilas

content: Saxano Juda Pe Tesalonaika Ri Tisui Na Pol Nare Sailas
Layaan re fo sangas falet la ro bina Amfipolis e Apalonia, re savat pe Tesalonaika e pave a toxan a lifu ina faxuvulan sina mu Juda.
E malaan sena vilaana sina, na Pol a laak lana lifu aave e la nu Yaan talatul ina Fangaafusan nane ferawai xuvul pari.

Nane xuus famatavas nari pana Ferawaian sina Piran talo ri taa texaas tuuna pana Mataa Failai e a maasaxan sina e pana to faꞌulaian sina ti la maatan. E nane kuus, “Na Yesus aanabeꞌ ve a Mataa Failai aava ne taxa xuus fatexaas nami pana.”
Saxano Juda ri xaveak namkai e ri faxuvul xuvul pa Pol nare Sailas e vaxa xaves ina mu Griik aava ri namkai sena Piran e maana matalava tefin sait.

Taasaxa saxano Juda ri tarasui nare e ri xel faxuvul a saxano rabuna saat ti la bina ina mamareiai e ri farawei fasorak a malila. E faasilak, mu rabuna xapiak pe la bina, ri felagafai. Ri falet fataapus xe la lifu si Jeson xena sengaan na Pol nare Sailas senaso ri vubuk o ri taa lisan nare xe la matana malila.

Taasaxa ri pife tingin nare. Ri raagan na Jeson xuvul pana xasanofuna aava ri namkai xe la matana mu paamua ina bina e ri xukulai, “A rovaat aava re fo puk a lamonan sina mu rabuna pe la nu bina, naboxo, re fo savat iau.
E na Jeson a kas a lifu sina xe sire. Nari xapiak ri taxa kawaasan a vuputkai sina king lava simaam, na Sisaa, layaan ri kuus o a toxan a xasa king, isina na Yesus.”
Layaan ri langai pana, a malila e mu paamua ina bina, ri felagafai pana ferawaian aanabeꞌ.
E mui nari aava ri waan xuvul pa Jeson ri mamareiai xe sina mu paamua ina bina e voxo ri mulus tapin nari.
A Matafanan Fulaa Pe Beria
Leaaf layaan a bina fesuk a mu fetinan, ri feng tapin na Pol nare Sailas xe Beria. Layaan re savat pave re laak la lifu ina faxuvulan sina mu Juda.

A mu rabuna pe Beria xo ri vubuk langai a lagasai, nari ve ri peraroxo sena mu Tesalonaika. La yaan saxa saxa ri lalamon pana Ferawaian sina Piran talo ri taa texaas o a ferawaian si Pol a tuuna o piau.
E maana Juda xaves ri namkai e maana Griik vaxa, a mu matalava tefin e tomexaan sait.
Taasaxa layaan a mu Juda pe Tesalonaika ri langai o na Pol taxa fapiti a mu Beria sait pana Ferawaian sina Piran, ri falet xe pave xena falagaf a xunus ina rabuna talo ri taa pife langai.
Fataapus a mu fetinan ri feng tapin na Pol xe paa la gun, taasaxa na Sailas nare Timoti re waan fatateak pe Beria.
A nutuvaat aava ri falet xuvul pa Pol, ri fe lisane xe Etens. E mui ri ulaa fulaa xe Beria pana fefasaian si Pol o na Sailas nare Timoti re taa filimaan fataapus xe sina.
Na Pol A Kanamsaat Faagut Sena Mu Piran Bit Pe Etens
Layaan na Pol taxa waan bang nare pe Etens nane kanamsaat faagut senaso a xalum a bina siri a bas pana maaradaang ina mu piran bit.
E voxo nane ferawai xe sina mu Juda e mu Griik aava ri suai sena Piran, lana lifu ina faxuvulan siri. E vaxa nane ferawai xe siri aava ri sangas la bina ina mamareiai.

E saxano rabuna ina fepitaian aava ri toxan a texaasan molava, ri fegagelai xuvul pa Pol. E saxanofuna ri kuus, “A mataa vungut aanabeꞌ i taxa kuus panaso?” E xasanofuna ri kuus, “Nane taxa ferawai pana saxano piran patak paaliu.” Ri kuus malaan senaso na Pol taxa ferawai pa Yesus e a to faꞌulaian sina.
E mui ri xel lisan na Pol xe la bina ina faxuvulan aava ri xalie pa Erapagas e pave ri xuuse, “Maam buk texaas sena fepitaian faꞌui siim.
Nano, no taxa ferawai pana maana mo patak e maam vubuk texaas sena.”
A mu rabuna ti Etens e mu topen aava ri taagul pave, vulai ri buk irimai xena fetalisan a maana lalamonan faꞌui.
Na Pol a tigina la palou ina bina ina faxuvulan aave e a kuus, “Rabuna ti Etens! Ne texaas o mi suai sena mu piran lana maana vilaana xapiak simi.

Senaso layaan ne sangas xolai la bina simi, ne xalum a nu bina mi taxa lo lotu lana e ne tingin vaxa a nobina saxa pana xakalayan aanabeꞌ: “Xe Sina Piran Aava Maam Vungut Sena”. E voxo a so ta mo mi taxa lotu xe sina lana vungutan simi, a mo aave ne taa xuus fatexaas nami pana.
A Piran aava vesan a xavala e maana mo lana, nane ve a Memai ina xunavata e xavala. E nane pife taagul lana lifu lotu aava rabuna ri vesane.
Piau ta mo nane vubuxane aava faisok sina mataa mon a fexaxaas sena tavaie pana senaso nane sang mon fuuna tavai a mu rabuna xapiak pana toyan e reref e a maana mo xapiak.

Nane vesan a mataa saxa e maana rabuna xapiak ri savat sena. E nane xa tavai nari pana nobina siri. Lumua nane lamon sena tangpat e fataxapiak ina rabuna e maana fafalas ina nobina ri taa taagul lana.
E nane vil malaane talo ri taa seng ta salan xe sina e naak ri taa tingine senaso a Piran pife lasuun paaliu setaara.
A saxa fo kuus, “Pana gutan sina Piran taara taagul e sangas e siak a reref” e saxano rabuna pana texaasan ti la palou imi, ri kuus malaan: “Nemaam sait maam rafulak sina.”
E voxo tamo taara xapiak ve taara mu rafulak sina Piran, taara taa pife lamon o a Piran a malaan sena maaradaang pana ‘gol’ o ‘silva’ o faat aava mataa fo vesane pana texaasan sina.
Lumua, layaan a mu rabuna ri vungut sena vilaana sina, a Piran a pife fakasanam nari, taasaxa naboxo, nane fasei a mu rabuna xapiak lana mu bina o ri taa puk tapai sena vilaana saat siri.

Senaso nane fo lamon faati sena yaan layaan a mataa aava nane fo fatie, i taa tiis a mu rabuna xapiak pana roxoyan. Nane fo faxalit a mu rabuna xapiak pana layaan nane fatatoi faꞌuli a mataa aave ti la maatan.”
Layaan na Pol a ferawai pana to faꞌulaian ti la maatan, saxano rabuna ri suaxane taasaxa saxanofuna ri kuus, “Maam vubuk langai fulan a ferawaian siim pana mo aanabeꞌ.”
E voxo na Pol a taꞌulan a faxuvulan aave.
E saxanu tuvaat aava ri buk waan xuvul pa Pol, ri namkai. La palou iri a saxa mataa, isina na Dionisus aava saxa ti lana Erapagas e saxa tefin, a isina na Damaris, re waan e saxanofuna sait.
